text: If someone doesn't like you, you shouldn't like them even more. I finally continue with videos about man's main rules, principles you should follow if you want to live a better, more stable life as a man. Think about how often you see this. A guy likes a girl, he tries to show appreciation, gives compliments, tries to get her attention, maybe even ask her out. And what does he get in return? Cold responses, dismissiveness, sometimes even disrespect. And instead of taking the hint, he thinks, maybe if I try a bit more, she will change her mind. Or even worse, in a relationship, the girl shows clear disrespect, cheats, contributes nothing. And he still tries to do more and more for her. Guys, please, have some self-respect. If someone doesn't like you, the answer is not to like them even more. Instead of trying to win over someone who clearly doesn't value you, you should have enough self-love to say, what the hell, she doesn't see how great a guy I am? Fine, her loss. I tried, she didn't accept it, I move on. There are too many people in this world to waste your time chasing someone who doesn't appreciate you. And this is not just about women or dating. This applies to everything. Friends, social circles, even work. Imagine you came to some event or you met some new people, but they treat you like you don't matter. They are arrogant or dismissive. The correct reaction is not to try harder to impress them. The correct reaction is to walk away. There are billions of people out there. Find those who will actually treat you nicely. Now, one important thing. This doesn't mean you should live in delusion. Yes, you should have a strong self-image, but at the same time, be honest with yourself. If you lack social skills, confidence or experience, acknowledge it and work on it. The goal is balance. Have self-respect, but also self-awareness. And once you build that, once you improve yourself and surround yourself with people who actually value you, you will naturally lose that urge to chase people who don't like you, because you will no longer need their validation. So remember this. If someone doesn't like you, you shouldn't like them even more. By the way, you can find other videos on men's principles under the playlist Men's Main Rules. Thanks and bye.
